{{Quote|Hmm &ndash; Ingon is such a talker; he really is rather tedious at the dining table. But I suppose I should aid Indinta &ndash; she'll owe me dearly for this one. Now let me see about assembling a suitable guest list for this party...|Briska Gil|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Briska Gil''' was a friend of [[Indintra Imbru Yerevan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNoble.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Briska Gil]]
Briska Gil was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who performed a series of [[:w:c:Quest|quests]] for [[Indintra Imbru Yerevan]] had deliver an invitation to Briska Gil.
